fact: The Lesotho News Agency reports the CAFI Entrepreneurship Hub launched its fifth cycle incubation programme with 60 enterprises selected, in priority sectors including digital innovation.

The World Bank says the CAFI Entrepreneurship Hub runs a six-month incubation period with mentoring and grants for selected enterprises, in five cohorts to date, and has supported 464 SMEs since 2022.
The Lesotho Times reports 54 enterprises took part in the CAFI six-month incubation programme this year, and the top 15 pitched to investors at its Demo Day.

CAFI's October 2026 newsletter, as reported by The Africa Capital Report, records 260 enterprises incubated under its entrepreneurship hub programme, with incubators receiving about US$100,000 per cohort.
Vodacom Lesotho launched its four-month Software Factory Hub incubation programme in Maseru, with five start-ups shortlisted from 37 applicants.

Public Eye reports that Limkokwing University's LEAP incubator ran a six-month incubation programme for 10 enterprises, one of five CAFI-trained enterprise support organisations including NUL Innovation Hub, BEDCO, TEN and Gem Institute.
